subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it changes plugin metadata interpretation for warnings and overlaps with sibling PRs, so the permanent compatibility contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept This Warn-Only Path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after rebase and exact-head checks because it covers planner callbacks, plugin registration wiring, malformed metadata guards, and regression tests without changing returned tool visibility.

options.title: Choose A Narrower Sibling
options.body: Select another open PR if maintainers prefer planner-only or descriptor-registration-only diagnostics, then close or supersede this branch after that path lands.

options.title: Request A Different Contract
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if malformed plugin availability should filter returned tools rather than only warn, since that is a stronger compatibility choice.

recommendation.title: Accept This Warn-Only Path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after rebase and exact-head checks because it covers planner callbacks, plugin registration wiring, malformed metadata guards, and regression tests without changing returned tool visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on plugin descriptor-cache and plugin tool resolution behavior, where the strongest current history points to steipete.
